Without deletion protection, a single `dynamodb delete-table` command permanently destroys the table and all its data. Enable this for any table containing production data.

checks.message: DynamoDB table deletion is permanent and immediate
checks.context: Deleting a DynamoDB table destroys all data, indexes, and streams. There is no recycle bin. Ensure you have a recent backup (on-demand backup or PITR) before proceeding.

checks.message: Batch write can delete or overwrite up to 25 items at once
